title: Interpret the Robot Location database model table fields to understand RMS station/orange location attributes
summary: A support user reviews the Robot Location database model table field list to explain how location attributes map to the RMS-displayed orange station locations (including station number, occupied status, zone/closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, and dwell-time tracking).
when_to_use: Use when you need to interpret which Robot Location model table fields define a location and how those fields correspond to the orange station locations shown on RMS (including how to classify location types/statuses and whether dwell tracking is enabled).
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for deeper database/model ownership support if the Robot Location model table does not contain the documented fields or the expected location-type/status list.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Access the database model table and identify the fields/attributes that define location station/orange location behavior; map location types/statuses and dwell-tracking flags to the RMS orange station concept.
access_or_tools_needed: SSMS / Helix/WCS database access to view the Robot Location database model table (exact access method not specified in the source).
Robot Location database model table (fields/columns as described in the segment).
RMS screen access for the orange locations/workstation ID concept (if used for cross-check).

access_required: SSMS / Helix/WCS database access to view the Robot Location database model table
RMS screen access (for orange locations/workstation ID cross-check, if used)

visual_references.description: Frame showing Robot Location database model table field list (station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell tracking) and the location types/statuses list; also references orange RMS locations and workstation ID/station concept; includes XY coordinate notes.

steps.title: Open the Robot Location database model table described in the training segment
steps.purpose: Get to the Robot Location database model table so you can review the exact location-defining fields and attributes.
steps.instruction: In SSMS / Helix/WCS database access, open the Robot Location database model table that contains the location information (station number, occupied status, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs allowed, and dwell-time tracking).
steps.expected_result: You can view the Robot Location database model table that includes the location attribute field list.
steps.healthy_condition: The Robot Location database model table is accessible and shows fields/attributes for station number, occupied status, zone, closeout zone, location type, max number of AGVs allowed, and dwell-time tracking.
steps.failure_condition: The Robot Location database model table is not accessible, or it does not contain the documented fields/attributes needed to interpret location station/orange location behavior.

actions.label: Open Robot Location database model table
actions.exact_action: Open the Robot Location database model table described in the segment

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Robot Location model table does not contain the documented fields needed for station/orange location interpretation, stop and escalate to deeper database/model ownership support (L3/vendor).

steps.title: Review the documented location attributes (station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell-time tracking)
steps.purpose: Identify which fields define the RMS orange station representation and its operational meaning.
steps.instruction: In the Robot Location database model table, locate and review the fields/attributes for: station number, occupied (occupied or not), zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of AGVs allowed at that location, and whether the location should be tracked for dwell time there.
steps.expected_result: You can point to the Robot Location model fields that correspond to: station number, occupied status, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs allowed, and dwell-time tracking.
steps.healthy_condition: All listed location attribute fields are present in the Robot Location database model table and can be referenced individually.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the required fields (station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell tracking) are missing or cannot be found in the Robot Location model table.

actions.label: Locate each location attribute field
actions.exact_action: Locate and review the documented fields/attributes: station number, whether it's occupied or not, zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of Agvs allowed at that location, and whether the location should be tracked for dwell time there.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Robot Location model table does not contain the documented fields/attributes, stop and escalate to deeper database/model ownership support (L3/vendor).

steps.title: Use the documented location types/statuses to classify the location type/status category
steps.purpose: Map a specific Robot Location record to the correct location type/status category used for RMS orange locations.
steps.instruction: From the Robot Location model table’s documented location types/statuses list, identify which category the location belongs to. Use the following categories: sorter entrance queue, sorter queue, sorter exit queue, tipper, tipper queue, tipper exit queue, hospital drop off, hospital entrance queue, hospital pickup, hospital exit queue, queue shut down, off the end shut down queue, GLD pre queue entrance, GLD pre queue exit.
steps.expected_result: You can select the correct location type/status category for the location based on the Robot Location model’s location type/status list.
steps.healthy_condition: The location type/status value you see in the Robot Location model table matches one of the documented categories (including sorter/tipper/hospital/shutdown/GLD pre-queue categories).
steps.failure_condition: The location type/status value cannot be matched to any of the documented categories, or the documented list is not present in the Robot Location model table context.

actions.label: Match location type/status to documented categories
actions.exact_action: Use the documented list of location types/statuses to identify which type/status category the location belongs to (e.g., sorter entrance queue, sorter queue, sorter exit queue, tipper, tipper queue, tipper exit queue, hospital drop off, hospital entrance queue, hospital pickup, hospital exit queue, queue shut down, off the end shut down queue, GLD pre queue entrance, GLD pre queue exit).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Robot Location model table does not contain the expected location-type/status list, stop and escalate to deeper database/model ownership support (L3/vendor).

steps.title: Cross-check that RMS orange locations correspond to stations identified via workstation ID
steps.purpose: Validate that the Robot Location model’s station concept aligns with the RMS orange station/orange segment concept.
steps.instruction: On RMS (orange locations view), use the workstation ID shown on the orange segments/locations to confirm that the orange locations correspond to stations that can be identified via workstation ID, consistent with the Robot Location model’s station concept.
steps.expected_result: You can correlate an RMS orange location/segment (where workstation ID is visible) to the station concept used in the Robot Location model.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS orange segments/locations show workstation ID, and the station concept aligns with the Robot Location model’s station representation.
steps.failure_condition: RMS orange locations cannot be correlated to stations via workstation ID, or the orange station concept does not align with the Robot Location model’s station mapping.

actions.label: Verify RMS orange segments show workstation ID
actions.exact_action: Cross-check the station concept: confirm that the orange locations shown on RMS correspond to stations that can be identified via workstation ID

stop_or_escalate_if: If the station mapping cannot be validated because the Robot Location model table does not support the documented station/orange location mapping concept, stop and escalate to deeper database/model ownership support (L3/vendor).

steps.title: Review coordinate fields (XY coordinates / lat-long) and units (centimeters)
steps.purpose: Provide spatial context for the location records when needed for interpretation.
steps.instruction: In the Robot Location database model table, review the coordinate fields: XY coordinates (not enums) that are provided as coordinates (lat/long) and are in centimeters.
steps.expected_result: You can identify the coordinate fields in the Robot Location model and explain that they represent XY coordinates (lat/long) in centimeters.
steps.healthy_condition: The Robot Location model includes coordinate fields described as XY coordinates (lat/long) and indicates they are in centimeters.
steps.failure_condition: Coordinate fields are missing, or they are not described as coordinates (lat/long) in centimeters in the Robot Location model context.

actions.label: Locate XY coordinate fields and confirm units
actions.exact_action: Review the documented coordinate fields: XY coordinates (lat/long) and that these are provided as coordinates (not enums) and are in centimeters

success_criteria: The user can point to the Robot Location model fields that define a location’s station/orange RMS representation (station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell-time tracking).
The user can classify a location into one of the documented location types/statuses categories used for RMS orange locations.
The user can correlate RMS orange segments/locations (with workstation ID visible) to the station concept used in the Robot Location model.
healthy_conditions: Robot Location database model table includes station number, occupied status, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs allowed, and dwell-time tracking.
Location type/status values match one of the documented categories (sorter/tipper/hospital/shutdown/GLD pre-queue).
RMS orange segments/locations show workstation ID and represent stations.
failure_conditions: Robot Location model table does not contain the documented fields/attributes needed for interpretation.
Robot Location model table does not contain the expected location-type/status list.
RMS orange locations cannot be correlated to stations via workstation ID.
escalation_guidance: If the Robot Location model table does not contain the documented fields or the expected location-type/status list, stop and escalate to deeper database/model ownership support (L3/vendor), since the source does not provide alternate field names.
